changelog:
Initial release of Seller Profit Calculator — upload any e-commerce order export and get instant profit reports.

- Supports Excel exports from all major platforms (Allegro, Temu, SHEIN, TikTok, Amazon, etc.)
- Instant breakdown by order, store, SKU, and platform, with top/bottom order highlights
- Automatic column mapping via built-in agent (no manual field mapping required)
- CLI tools for parsing and analysis: parse_orders.py and analyze_headers.py
- Free to install; tiered pricing for cloud features; validated on real merchant data
summary: Multi-platform Order Profit Calculator — upload order exports from any e-commerce platform or ERP, get instant profit reports by order, store, SKU, and platf...
